title: President s Salary Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: President s Salary Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXVI OF 2018
ACT XXXVI OF 2018
PRESIDENT'S SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the President's Salary,
Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
4th June, 2018]
No. F.
22(16)/2018-Legis, dated 1.6.2018.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 31st
May, 2018 is hereby published for general information:-
WHEREAS it is
expedient further to amend the President's Salary, Allowances and Privileges
Act, 1975 (LVIII of 1975), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the President's Salary,
Allowances and Privileges (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

sections.description:
Substitution of section 3, Act LVIII of 1975

ACT XXXVI OF 2018
ACT XXXVI OF 2018
PRESIDENT'S SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the President's Salary,
Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
4th June, 2018]
No. F.
22(16)/2018-Legis, dated 1.6.2018.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 31st
May, 2018 is hereby published for general information:-
WHEREAS it is
expedient further to amend the President's Salary, Allowances and Privileges
Act, 1975 (LVIII of 1975), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
2. Substitution of
section 3, Act LVIII of 1975.---In the President's
Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975 (LVIII of 1975), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, for section 3, the following shall be substituted,
namely:-
"3. Monthly
Salary.---(1) The Government shall pay per month salary to the President as
specified in the Fourth Schedule.
(2) The Government
may, by notification in the official Gazette, amend the Fourth schedule to
increase the salary of the President keeping in view the guiding principle that
the remuneration of the President shall be a symbolic one rupee higher than the
salary of any holder of public office in relation to affairs of the
Federation.".
